title: An exact linear functor induces a linear functor on derived categories
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and let $\mathcal A,\mathcal B$ be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian] with $R$-linear structures [def-weil-linear-category]. Work in universes where their unbounded derived categories exist [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], equipped with the induced $R$-linear structures of [lem-weil-linear-abelian-derived-category]. Let $F:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ be additive and preserve finite limits and finite colimits, and suppose $F$ is $R$-linear [def-weil-linear-functor]. The termwise induced functor $D(F):D(\mathcal A)\to D(\mathcal B)$ of [lem-sf-exact-functor-derived-triangulated] is $R$-linear: for every pair of parallel derived morphisms $f,g$ and every $r\in R$, $D(F)(f+g)=D(F)(f)+D(F)(g)$ and $D(F)(rf)=rD(F)(f)$.

source.place: CategoryTheory.Functor.instLinearDerivedCategoryMapDerivedCategory, lines 120-125 (instance starts at line 122); global exactness and derived-category hypotheses at lines 27-30; mapDerivedCategory at lines 35-37.

Additivity is already part of the induced triangulated functor of lem-sf-exact-functor-derived-triangulated.
